$comment: Demo pacing (npm run demo): the ONE place the scripted day's timing lives. Milliseconds at 1x; the 2x and 4x keys divide every wait. Each wait sits in front of a mock call (text turn, image, web call) or after a stage ends, so the real engine and its events set the order and these numbers set only the rhythm. Tuned for about 3 minutes in total at 1x.
